original_prompts.name: Tainted Claude-chan
original_prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create the tainted alternate version of this exact Claude-chan full-body portrait for the same game. Preserve her recognizable face, sunflower hair ornament, elegant anatomy, overall pose, book, and premium anime illustration quality. Change the hair to deep crimson, dress to layered charcoal and black with restrained dark red and antique gold trim, make the sunflower slightly wilted, book cover worn and closed with red ribbon, expression quietly defiant and tired but beautiful. Keep full body and shoes visible. No injuries, no blood, no letters, no company logos. Actual transparent RGBA isolated character, no backdrop or glow. This is the tainted alternate of the credited ZipZipPipe design, noncommercial derivative.
